zoe (People Ops): Hi all — quick thread to capture follow-ups from today’s all-hands around promotions, pay timing, and manager guidance. Post questions here.
mike (VP Eng): Short answers: approvals by 25th -> effective 1st; letters within 3 biz days; managers tell people ASAP.
arjun (IC): If I disagree with level outcome, whats the path?
zoe (People Ops): First talk to your manager + people partner. If still unresolved, submit an appeal form (link in manager kit). Target decision: 10 business days.
kai (Finance): Payroll cutoff = 25th PT. Retro shows as "Promo Retro" line; taxed normally. If approved after cutoff, retro may post in next or following run.
promo-bot: Reminder: calibration mtg Thu 10am PT. Upload docs by Wed 8pm PT.
zoe (People Ops): Well drop a 1:1 checklist and announcement templates to the manager kit by EOD. Team-first announcements recommended; People Ops will post company-wide blurb after manager sign-off.
